## Current Appointments

::: {.timeline}
::: {.timeline-item}
### CONICET Doctoral Fellow

**2025–present**

My doctoral work explores predictive and generative modeling of RNA secondary structure, supervised by Prof. Diego H. Milone and Dr. Leandro Bugnon.
:::

::: {.timeline-item}
### Teaching Assistant

**Facultad de Ingeniería y Ciencias Hídricas, Universidad Nacional del Litoral · 2026–present**

I teach Neural Networks I and Neural Networks II as an *Ayudante de Primera* in the [Ingeniería en Inteligencia Artificial](https://www.unl.edu.ar/carreras/ingenieria-en-inteligencia-artificial/) program.
:::

## Education

**PhD in Engineering – Computational Intelligence**, Universidad Nacional del Litoral, 2025–present<br>
Thesis topic: generative models for joint sequence-structure representations and RNA ensembles.

**Licentiate Degree in Physics**, Universidad Nacional de Rosario, 2016–2024<br>
Thesis on machine-learning simulations of dissociative adsorption of methane on Pt(110)-(1×2).

## Previous Research

**Instituto de Física Rosario (IFIR), UNR-CONICET · 2022–2024**<br>
EVC-CIN undergraduate research fellow working on neural-network interatomic potentials and computational simulations of methane adsorption on platinum surfaces.
